statements.t: We are focused on growing our wealth management business through strategic additions of experienced financial advisors in our existing branch system and employment of experienced money management personnel in our asset management business as well as deploying our capital for expansion through targeted acquisitions or new branch openings.

We are also focused on opportunities in our capital markets businesses, including integrating new technology platforms to expand the suite of services offered to our clients and onboarding experienced personnel and/or small units that will improve our ability to attract institutional clients in both equities and fixed income without significantly raising our risk profile.

The new guidance, which becomes effective for the Company beginning in 2027, will not have an impact on our financial position or results of operations because it requires only additional disclosures.
We will continue to review our historical treatment of these earnings to determine whether our historical practice will continue or whether a change is warranted.

A second closing is expected to occur in January 2027, pursuant to which the Company expects to purchase approximately C$338,000 of additional shares directly from existing shareholders, funded using available cash resources.

Based on the Company's current liquidity position, available cash resources and capital levels, management does not expect completion of the remaining transaction to have a material adverse effect on the Company's liquidity, capital resources or financial condition.

The proposed premises are expected to have a smaller footprint than the Company’s existing headquarters, with occupancy costs expected to be generally consistent with those of the existing headquarters.
If an agreement is reached, the Company currently expects to occupy the new premises in phases beginning in 2028.

The Company expects to fund its anticipated capital requirements from existing liquidity and cash generated from operations and does not currently expect the potential lease to have a material adverse effect on its liquidity or capital resources.

The Company maintains processes and systems with an aim to preventing any such attack from disrupting its services to clients as well as to prevent any loss of client or Company funds or data concerning its clients, their financial affairs, as well as Company-privileged information.

As of the date of this filing, the Company has not identified any cybersecurity threats that have materially affected or are reasonably anticipated to have a material effect on the Company’s business strategy, results of operations or financial condition.
Given the continuing reports of cyber incidents in general, we believe that the Company will most likely continue to be a target of cybersecurity attacks by bad actors.

If there are no further changes or amendments to Section 162(m), or if the definition of "covered employees" is further expanded, we expect the Company's operating results to be adversely impacted due to anticipated increases in the Company's income tax expense and effective tax rate.

Based on our current assessment of compensation arrangements and employee populations that would be subject to the expanded definition of covered employees, had the amendments been effective during fiscal 2025, we estimate that the resulting reduction in deductible compensation would have increased income tax expense by approximately $7 million.
The Company currently intends to continue reporting results on a quarterly basis subject to its review of any final rule and any related regulatory requirements.
